name: Tsi-chi’s Grandma
source:
She died of illness in 2014.
After her death, she asked Lam Lam for help to rescue her beloved grandson, Yau Tsi-chi, who was being haunted by a grudge spirit of a fan who could not be liberated.
Lam Lam could see her but not hear her words, making communication difficult.
However, she was able to rescue him by consulting with Madam Fen through Yvet.
After the exorcism was completed and the crisis was over, she still followed Yau Tsi-chi around for some reason.
Lam Lam, however, did not tell him about it.
